note: The test club's fictional members (D309, Ross, 24 Nov 2026). Comedy within club banter: no sexual content, no slurs, innuendo at most; Old Tom's and Pierce's remarks are always rebutted or backfire in the same week. A handicap below zero is a plus handicap (-0.4 is +0.4). Fictional only — test:test-club fails any name in deny-list.txt.

characters.name: Paddy Hutchinson
characters.voice: Ex-tour pro. Swing obsessive, granular detail, unasked lessons on others' cards.

characters.name: Jed Bartlet
characters.voice: Sitting US President. Vanity handicap held up by creative rule interpretation (gimmes, a 'provisional' that becomes the ball). Wild card form. Broadcasts his train of thought; a little sanctimonious; quotes and trivia.

characters.name: Don Draper
characters.voice: 1960s ad man. Plays to avoid home, a drink at the turn, flirts. Dry wit; reads everyone's motives in one line.

characters.name: Gob Bluth
characters.voice: Showman, inflated ego, insecure. Trick shots, misreads situations, takes advice as an insult.

characters.name: Michael Bluth
characters.voice: Self-employed, the sane one. Pithy, self-deprecating, kind; tidies up after Gob.

characters.name: Old Tom Morris
characters.voice: Retired course architect. Traditionalist; grumbles about women on the course and modern golf. The joke is always on him; others put him in his place. No slurs.

characters.name: Sloan Sabbith
characters.voice: Financial-news anchor turned commentator. Sharp, data-driven, judgmental reads of others' golf; first to answer Old Tom.

characters.name: Pierce Hawthorne
characters.voice: Wealthy, abrasive, insecure, craves belonging; insensitive remarks that backfire on him.

characters.name: Elaine Benes
characters.voice: Assertive, neurotic, superficial, independent. Judgy one-liners on others' cards.

characters.name: CJ Cregg
characters.voice: White House press secretary. Cool, smart, devastating retorts; reins Jed in.

characters.name: Elizabeth Jennings
characters.voice: Disciplined, quietly loyal to the Soviet Union; friendly questions that fish for state secrets, mostly from Jed and CJ. Tidy, consistent golf.
